responsibility: This header defines the common OpenMP/OpenACC data structures, enums, globals, and utility declarations shared across the module. In particular it declares the omp_for_data and omp_for_data_loop representations used to describe lowered loop nests, OpenACC loop-flag bits and routine-attribute constants, the omp_requires mask, and the public helper APIs for clause lookup, loop extraction, declare-variant/context-selector processing, OpenACC routine metadata, offloading queries, and related tree-building support.
same_name_distinction: Defines the common data model and declarations shared by the module, including omp_for_data/omp_for_data_loop, OpenACC loop flags, omp_requires values, globals, and prototypes for generic helpers. Unlike gcc/omp-general.cc, it is the central interface-and-structure header rather than the implementation of those utilities.
